lines.speaker: header
lines.text: CALUMET COUNTY SHERIFF'S DEPARTMENT Page 764 Complaint No. 05-0157-955 File Number

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: I look at it this way, we're giving you another opportunity, we didn't need to come back here. I-if we sit here and we feel that you're not being honest with you, we could just leave. So you go back by the fire you said.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: Is that true or is that not true?

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: We don't want you to tell us anything that's not true. I'd rather not, I'd rather have you not tell us anything than ta, ta sit here and make things up, because it's not gonna look good for you. You started to shake your head wh-when Mark just asked you that, i-is that not true, you went back by the fire. Tell us what happened.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: Brendan, Brendan, look at me, Brendan just look up for a second. It's very important here that you be honest, OK? Tom said w-we can just walk out the door. I mean you're the one who wanted to talk with us OK? So let's, let's go back a little bit OK? What have ya lied about so far?

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: OK. So when you go over to the house, do you go inside right away or do you go to the fire?

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: And what does he tell you?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: Just that he was gonna help, I was gonna help 'em pick up the yard.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: Did he tell you anything about Teresa at that time?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: Then after we got cleaned up the yard a little bit and we unloaded the stuff near the fire and after a while he told me that he wanted to show me somethin' in the house.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: Did he say what he wanted to show you?
